skills: Up to 4 Physical hits that heal him a little. During the 4th, press Special for a Drive Suppression that costs half the HP.
Hold with 100 Determination: spends it on a motorcycle charge and laser for massive Physical DMG.

During Drive Suppression, steer or hold dodge: a drift that can Perfect Dodge (into Afterfire Spin). Keeps Drive Suppression's timer running into Cool Wheelie; stopping early gives Run Wild. Briefly invulnerable.
Arm-cannon blast for Physical DMG. From a Perfect Dodge it heals 10% Max HP on hit and flows into the 4th Basic hit.
Perfect Dodge during Through the Galaxy: a spinning Physical hit around him, then Cool Wheelie.
Arm-cannon blast for Physical DMG; above 25% HP it's a Drive Suppression instead (once per 5s).
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Kicks his motorcycle at the target for massive Physical DMG.
Costs 16% Max HP: rams enemies on his motorcycle for continuous Physical DMG. Getting hit right as it starts blocks the attack (+5 Determination) into Cool Wheelie; otherwise it ends in Cool Wheelie.
When Through the Galaxy is cut short: kicks the motorcycle at enemies for Physical DMG; flows into Duel King.
Wheelie attack for Physical DMG (+8 Determination on hit). With enough Adrenaline, press into Rocking Footwork; otherwise ends in Run Wild.
Hold with enough Adrenaline: motorcycle slam for Physical DMG; heals 30% Max HP.
After Cool Wheelie: bike and cannon combo for Physical DMG; heals 15% Max HP.
Combo for massive Physical DMG; +15 Determination.
Leaping flying kick for massive Physical DMG.

core.name: Knight's Resolve
core.text:
Gains 0.1 Sheer Force per point of Max HP; all his Physical DMG is Sheer DMG, ignoring DEF. Enters battle with 60 Adrenaline (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).
Above 25% HP, Special spends HP on Drive Suppression; each use in combat gives +{0}% CRIT DMG for 45s. At 25% HP or less, he takes 50% less DMG.
Determination (max 120) comes from hits, slowly over time, Cool Wheelie, Knight's Swagger, blocks, and Perfect Dodges (3, once per 0.5s).

ability.name: Blazing Starlight
ability.text: Cool Wheelie, his 4th Basic hit, Chain and Ultimate give 1 Starlight (max 2, 45s, one per use): +20% DMG each to Chain, Ultimate, EX Specials and Full-Throttle Starlight.

mindscapes: Enters battle with 60 more Adrenaline. EX Special hits make him ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s.

Full-Throttle Starlight, Cool Wheelie and Ultimate +50% DMG. Rocking Footwork, High-Traction Wheels, or Drive Suppression on a Stunned enemy give Turbocharged (max 1): his next Drive Suppression jumps straight into Cool Wheelie with +50% CRIT DMG.
Each Drive Suppression gives +8% CRIT DMG (max 2, 45s). Off-field below 35% HP, he slowly heals back to 35%.

Ultimate and Full-Throttle Starlight Sheer DMG +18%. His 4th Basic hit, Cool Wheelie and Knight's Swagger give Brilliant Starlight (max 6); his Ultimate or Full-Throttle Starlight spends up to 2 for +100% Sheer Force as Physical DMG each.
